note: verified = taken from the platform's own help page that day; otherwise third-party sources that disagree, so limits only WARN. Re-check before relying on a hard limit.

reels.label: Instagram Reels
sources: third-party: up to 20 min accepted; over 3 min not recommended to non-followers

tiktok.label: TikTok
sources: third-party: 10 min in-app, up to 60 min uploaded; varies by account

shorts.label: YouTube Shorts
sources: third-party: Shorts up to 3 min since 2024-10-15

youtube.label: YouTube
sources: support.google.com/youtube/answer/1722171: MP4 faststart, H.264 High, 2 B-frames, closed GOP of half the frame rate, CABAC, 4:2:0, AAC-LC 48 kHz 384 kbps stereo, 1080p30 8 Mbps / 1080p60 12 Mbps recommended

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
sources: third-party: 3 s to 15 min from desktop (10 min mobile), 5 GB, aspect 1:2.4 to 2.4:1, 256x144 to 4096x2304

x.label: X
sources: unverified: 2 min 20 s and 512 MB for most accounts; longer for paid tiers
